sources.label: Google reviews and posts (Google Business Profile API)

does: Drafts a reply to each new Google review, warm for 5 stars, calm and flagged RED for 3 stars or less
Suggests a Google Business post for the venue that has gone longest without one

traits.cant: Post a reply or a Google post
traits.instead: Drafts it with a copy button for a person to post

traits.cant: Read reviews on WeddingWire, The Knot or other sites
traits.instead: Reads Google reviews and posts straight from Google every morning (ORDER #2977)

traits.cant: Promise a refund, discount or change
traits.instead: Offers a direct line to sales@
